title: Habibi: Laying the Open-Source Foundation of Unified-Dialectal Arabic Speech Synthesis

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis performance disparities across various high- and low-resource Arabic dialects using objective metrics (Word Error Rate, Speaker Similarity, and Naturalness), and specifically employing both multilingual and dialect-specific ASR models to mitigate and account for cross-dialect recognition bias.
